status: READ_ONLY_OPERATOR_PREPARATION; no render buffer, RGB, query data, feature or model execution
purpose: Construct fixed source query-error emulation for the NEW registered procedural native8 assets using the deployed q8/context/L/crop operator. This does not correct actual initializer queries or establish legacy/human-native equivalence.

deployment_available_inputs.q8: First8 original initializer predicted camera-facing keypoints in native image pixels; missing/sentinel retained. Ninth centroid does not enter native8 crop/context.
deployment_available_inputs.frame: Original raw RGB and native H/W
deployment_available_inputs.logical_slot: Camera-facing index for output bookkeeping/label join; not a numeric learned-head feature
deployment_available_inputs.selection: Frozen initializer picks first argmax confidence candidate, not GT-nearest/best visible target. This synthetic pilot has one explicitly constructed target, so source instance association is fixed independently of visibility.

teacher_only.native_R: Projected unchanged registered physical anchor, keyed by canonical index; camera/pose/K known from synthetic construction
teacher_only.witness: Designated primary physical part and37 endpoint/face/edge witnesses per canonical corner; owner/depth/ray/S/D/E/U evidence remains GT-only
forbidden_in_forward: reference r or jitter error magnitude
part/instance owner maps, masks, depth, pose/K
visibility labels or protected uncertainty/witness regions
teacher_only.source_generation_caveat: Source q emulation intentionally starts from projected reference plus prospective errors. It is teacher-derived query emulation, not actual initializer output or a blind GT-free acquisition claim. Once q8 is frozen, crop construction uses q8/HW/RGB only.

canonical_CF_contract.axes: Canonical +X right,+Y down,+Z far; near face0..3. New assets use constructed physical anchors in this convention.
canonical_CF_contract.mapping: perm[cf_index]=canonical_index. After projection of the actual source pose: r_cf[j]=projected_r_canonical[perm[j]], and rawstate_cf[j]=rawstate_canonical[perm[j]]. Apply exactly once; retain both indices and signed yaw assignment.
canonical_CF_contract.pose: Use the fixed known synthetic mesh-to-camera pose already rendered. Do not fit PnP, recenter reference, rotate projected points a second time, sort by image x/y, or select the nearest visible point.
canonical_CF_contract.four_yaws: Only complete signed YAW_0/90/180/270 assignments define correspondence. W/D parity alone is insufficient. For the currently fixed yaw0 scene, use the recorded identity mapping; do not infer a different facing convention from appearance.
canonical_CF_contract.scope: Exact canonical-to-part registration is constructive for these NEW assets only. It is not a recovered association for historical mesh/native-human annotations.

proposed_query_emulation_not_executed.minimal_expansion: For every original native query j=0..7 and each predeclared offset, start with the same complete r_cf8; replace only q8[j]=r_cf[j]+delta. Other7 q8 entries stay fixed for this one-query-error condition. Retain every slot/condition; no GT-best slot or error selection.

proposed_query_emulation_not_executed.after_offset: Recompute both L and context from the resulting complete q8, exactly as deployment. L0 only defines the prospective perturbation size; do not reuse it as final L if the shifted q8 extent changes.
proposed_query_emulation_not_executed.centre: Centre condition retained, with explicit duplicate namespace if both families later used; no silent dedup/filter by labels.
proposed_query_emulation_not_executed.invalid: Missing/nonfinite source projection stays missing, not jittered into a fake finite point. Finite OOB q/r and all S/U remain in records; preserve factual input failure separately.
proposed_query_emulation_not_executed.limitations: One-slot perturbation is a controlled localization-error model, not the full correlated error distribution of a real detector. Adding a common/global8 perturbation would be a separate prospective condition, not an automatic change.

deterministic_input_operator.L: If>=2 good points: clip(0.25*max(ptp(q_good,x),ptp(q_good,y)),16,max(H,W)); else16. Exactly the V60 native_grid formula.
deterministic_input_operator.context: If>=2 good points and positive x and y extents: [minx,miny,maxx,maxy] of all finite non-sentinel q8. No expansion, clipping or fallback to GT/reference/selected bbox. Otherwise missing context.
deterministic_input_operator.local96: s_jk=q_j+(((k+0.5)/96)-0.5)*L peraxis. F64 bilinear weights, zero out-of-native neighbours, floor(clip(acc,0,255)+0.5) toU8. Valid iff -0.5<=sx<W-0.5 and -0.5<=sy<H-0.5; invalid output exactlyzero.
deterministic_input_operator.local_query_phase: Native q is between96 pixels47/48, local coordinate47.5. Forward display inverse j=(native-q)*96/L+47.5. No nearest/snap moves q.
deterministic_input_operator.context224: sample native at lo+(k+0.5)*span/224. Bilinear float32 RGB after F64 accumulation; validity requires every strictly positive bilinear neighbour in native image. No integer PIL crop approximation.
deterministic_input_operator.preprocessing: Full96 and literal central[32:64,32:64] invalid pixels filled with ImageNet mean; independently resized224 bilinear align_corners=False antialias=True, then standard mean/std. Context224 uses same meanfill/normalization without a second resize.
deterministic_input_operator.factual_availability: q finite/non-sentinel AND continuous native [0,W)x[0,H) AND nearest floor(q+.5) inbounds AND literal RGB96 central4 valid. Combined model availability additionally requires any supported context pixel. Qinside is a feature, not a new U gate.
deterministic_input_operator.labels: Teacher D/E/S/U is computed from original registered reference/witness before choosing q error. Perturbing q does not redefine the reference into the observed q pixel. Raw teacher state, input availability, query error, and pixel owner diagnostic remain separate.
deterministic_input_operator.source_boundary: BEFORE/COVER/SHAM share exactly the same q8/jitter/slot/L/context when geometry/camera are unchanged. Teacher or foreign-patch success must not set query_available. No output point correction/PnP.
